reason: A cross-platform Tauri desktop shell that opens the local dsh web interface and can start and stop its locally launched backend process.

summaries.zh: 一个使用 Tauri 封装本机 dsh web 界面的跨平台桌面应用，可按需启动和停止由应用启动的本地后端。
summaries.en: A cross-platform Tauri desktop shell for the local dsh web interface that can start and stop the backend process it launches.

capabilities: Launches the local dsh web command
Provides a cross-platform desktop shell for the local dsh web interface
Manages the backend process started by the application
